cc:Work.dc:title: Actual MuonH local language-model pilot
cc:Work.dc:description: Tiny Shakespeare, 624640-parameter three-layer Transformer, CPU FP32. Actual ELR schedules and three paired-seed validation CE means with sample-standard-deviation bands. Common peak selected only from AIR development validation. No claim of actual-training optimality. All axes linear.
